# MEE audio

> MEE audio is a leading manufacturer of wireless and wired headphones, in-ear monitors, and audio accessories for consumers and professionals since 2005.

MEE audio offers a comprehensive range of audio products including truly wireless earbuds, Bluetooth headphones, professional monitors, sports headphones, and specialized solutions for TV viewing, travel, and children's safe listening. The company serves diverse audiences from casual listeners to professional musicians.

## Key Topics

- Bluetooth wireless audio
- Truly wireless earbuds
- TV headphones with aptX
- In-ear monitors
- SleepTones sleeping earbuds
- KidJamz volume-limiting headphones
- Connect transmitter systems
- Sports headphones
- Professional musician earplugs
- USB-C audio
- 3.5mm wired headphones
- Wireless speakers
- Audio accessories
- Travel audio solutions
- 4K webcams

## Wireless Headphones & Earbuds

- [Truly Wireless Headphones](https://meeaudio.com/collections/trulywireless): Truly wireless earbuds collection including Pebbles and AirHooks Pro models
- [MEE Wireless](https://meeaudio.com/collections/wireless): Complete wireless headphone line with Bluetooth, TV, and sports models
- [MEE Sport](https://meeaudio.com/collections/sport): Sports headphones collection with secure fit and sweat resistance features
- [Headphones for TV](https://meeaudio.com/collections/home-tv): TV wireless headphones with low-latency aptX technology and CinemaEAR

## Wired Headphones & Specialized Audio

- [Wired Headphones](https://meeaudio.com/collections/wired): Wired headphone collection including M6, SleepTones, and KidJamz models
- [SleepTones](https://meeaudio.com/collections/sleeptones): SleepTones sleeping earbuds in wired USB-C and 3.5mm options
- [MEE audio KidJamz Safe Listening Headphones for Kids](https://meeaudio.com/collections/kids): KidJamz volume-limiting headphones for safe children's listening experience

## Professional Audio & Monitoring

- [All In-Ear Monitors](https://meeaudio.com/collections/all-in-ear-monitors): MEE Professional in-ear monitors for musicians with custom options
- [Custom & Universal Ear Plugs for Musicians](https://meeaudio.com/collections/earplugs): MEE Professional musician earplugs with custom molding and interchangeable filters

## Wireless Audio Systems & Transmitters

- [Connect for TV](https://meeaudio.com/collections/connect-transmitters): Connect Bluetooth transmitter systems for TV and in-flight entertainment
- [Connect Transmitters](https://meeaudio.com/collections/transmitters): Wireless Bluetooth transmitters for TV, travel, and audio streaming
- [Connect Receivers](https://meeaudio.com/collections/receivers): Connect wireless audio receivers and transmitter-receiver systems
- [TV Headphone Bundles](https://meeaudio.com/collections/headphone-bundles): Bundled wireless TV headphone systems with Connect transmitters
- [For Travel](https://meeaudio.com/collections/for-travel): Travel audio collection with in-flight wireless adapters and transmitters

## Speakers & Audio Devices

- [Speakers](https://meeaudio.com/collections/speakers-mee): Wireless Bluetooth speakers including goSPKR and partySPKR models
- [Webcams](https://meeaudio.com/collections/webcams): 4K Ultra HD webcams for conferencing and live streaming applications

## Accessories & Support

- [Accessories](https://meeaudio.com/collections/accessories): Replacement parts and accessories including eartips, cables, cases
- [Other Cables & Adapters](https://meeaudio.com/collections/cables-adapters-mee): Audio cables, adapters, and connectors for MEE audio products
- [Contact](https://meeaudio.com/pages/contact): Contact information and customer support resources for MEE audio
